description: This file defines the ProjectCostsForm class, which manages a form for editing project costs within the Goteo project, including adding, removing, and validating costs data.

classes.name: ProjectCostsForm
classes.description: A form processor class for managing project costs, allowing adding, removing, default value retrieval, validation, and saving of costs data associated with a project.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for a given form field, applying NotBlank constraints based on validation mode and field name.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default values for the form fields based on existing project costs, optionally sanitizing the data.

methods.name: delCost
methods.description: Removes a cost entry from the internal costs array and updates form builder accordingly.

methods.name: addCost
methods.description: Adds a new cost to the form, including its fields and validation constraints.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with a title and existing costs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists the form data, updating project costs and handling errors.

methods.name: getCostsAsChoices
methods.description: Generates choices array for cost types to be used in form options.

methods.name: getRequiredCostChoices
methods.description: Provides choices for whether a cost is required or not.
